description: §6.13.5 (S479): a `throttled=1s` engine cell at Idle. Click #finish: the leading write commits at once and Idle -> Done violates `rule=` — the runtime E-ENGINE-INVALID-TRANSITION is a trap of the click handler and the cell keeps .Idle. Click #load with no time advanced: the refused commit opened no window, so this write is a leading commit too (Idle -> Loading, at once). XFAIL on impl#1: it parses neither the §66 `single` engine opener nor a timed engine (S471 policy: impl#1 is frozen; carried gap g-impl1-timed-engine-commit-s479).
rationale: §6.13.5: "A committed write that violates `rule=` is the runtime `E-ENGINE-INVALID-TRANSITION`: the cell keeps its prior value, no `<onTransition>` handler runs, and the violation is a trap (§19.17) of the unit the commit runs in — the event handler for a commit that lands at once (a throttle's leading write)". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 8. (That a refused leading commit opens no window is the bootstrap's reading: nothing was emitted, §6.13.2.)
